material: Polyacrylamide gel, 3% acrylamide, 0.08% bisacrylamide, poly-D-lysine/matrigel coated

formulation.evidence: Gels were prepared with 3% acrylamide and bisacrylamide (bis) ranging from 0.04 to 0.2%.
Figure 2 shows neurons cultured for 7 days on a soft gel (0.08% bisacrylamide, ~2300 dyne/cm2

processing.evidence: Final gel thickness after polymerization was ~100 μm.
left on gels for 1–2 h at 37°C for cross-linking
A bifunctional cross-linker (50 μM sulfo-SANPAH (Pierce, Rockford, IL) in 200 mM HEPES,
167 μg/ml matrigel (Becton Dickinson, Franklin Lakes, NJ) in EMEM was applied at 8.67 μg/cm2

youngs_modulus.evidence: Figure 2 shows neurons cultured for 7 days on a soft gel (0.08% bisacrylamide, ~2300 dyne/cm2

biology.cell_type: primary spinal cord neurons (E13.5 embryos, C57BL/6J)

culture_days.evidence: Figure 2 shows neurons cultured for 7 days on a soft gel (0.08% bisacrylamide, ~2300 dyne/cm2

neurite_length.evidence: Neurites extend quite far on the gels, on average 0.8 mm from the cell body, and form multiple branches along their length.

other_outcomes.evidence: No glia were observed on any of the gels even after several weeks in culture
other_outcomes.name: glial presence

notes: Shear modulus measured by cone-and-plate rheometry at room temperature, 5% strain, 10 rad/s. Discussion also cites ~2500 dyne/cm2 for 0.08% bis gels. Softer gels showed more neurite branching.
